metric: Completed checklist milestones / six milestones; not total game coverage.

sections.name: Models
sections.scope: Larger imported characters and skeleton compatibility
findings: Native mesh packets, weights, bone groups and coordinate encoding mapped.
GLB/Blender export and native mesh construction exist.
remaining: Larger characters still need full scene and cutscene regression.
Successful individual mods do not validate arbitrary geometry or bone counts.

sections.name: Textures
sections.scope: Larger textures, upload queues and memory ownership
findings: Texture decoding, storage layouts and packet construction inspected.
Native allocation/upload checks exist beyond basic 128×128 replacements.
remaining: VRAM residency, asynchronous cleanup and shared-scene regressions remain.

sections.name: Animation
sections.scope: Extended skeletons, transition readers and lifetime
findings: Native animation reading/writing and targeted transition tests exist.
remaining: User reports Raiden still stretches in V5 and V6 cutscenes.
Full scene transitions and all character users are not verified.

sections.name: ADX music
findings: WAV conversion, native header/frame decoding and loop callbacks inspected.
Baseline ADX editing already exists in Studio.
remaining: Latest codec/pipeline changes need game regression and a verified release.
Baseline feature availability is separate from this research checklist.

sections.name: Grunts & effects
sections.scope: Native DTPK / PS2 ADPCM sound-bank replacements
findings: Native banks decoded; WAV-to-ADPCM encoding and bank round trips checked.
EE/IOP upload, named events and failure paths investigated.
remaining: Game test lost grunts and special-move sounds.
Offline success has not established safe game sound-bank replacement.
Work paused at user request while SFD replacement is investigated.

sections.name: SFD movies
sections.scope: New movies within native dimensions, byte budget and duration
findings: All eight retail movie profiles mapped against ELF metadata.
New MPEG-2 SFDs passed PC decoding across all eight profiles.
Original audio topology and compressed sound frames retained.
Oversized, overlong and mismatched-profile replacements rejected.
Studio export, review, staging and saved movie projects implemented.
59 synthetic write checks cover neighboring data, padding and both size fields.
remaining: Studio 0.27.13 distributes experimental movie import; validated gameplay release remains pending.
Full rebuilt-disc playback and hardware/emulator regression remain unverified.
High-resolution expansion is outside this first native-size milestone.

sections.name: Archives
sections.scope: Expanded resource placement and runtime loading
findings: ISO/WAD reading and rebuilding exist; archive and AFS paths inspected.
Targeted native loader and repack tests exist.
remaining: On-disc placement and runtime pool limits are separate.
End-to-end expanded-asset regressions and failure recovery remain.

sections.name: Levels & collision
sections.scope: Complete editable stages and collision round trips
findings: Stage/model previews and selected collision record structures inspected.
remaining: Selected record codecs do not establish a complete editable stage format.
Complete stage reimport, triggers, collisions and gameplay regression remain.
